text: The photo shows a lab/exhibition bench setup against a pale grey wall. Centre: a dark grey rectangular rack or frame with two large open window-like cut-outs, standing upright on a white platform; a small metallic clamp or fitting sits inside the right opening. Below and in front are white and light grey panels and a slotted aluminium extrusion base, with white blocks on top. Right: a vertical grey metal post with a row of round bolt heads, and black cables running down behind the rack. Upper right: a white and magenta sign bearing a QR-style square marker and Chinese text with "Robot Prod..." partly visible. Left background: a white boxy instrument with a black arm and a small QR marker label. No liquids or containers are visible.
